title: Structure preview for the example document formatter

target_version_constraints.condition: Installed version is unknown; verify before treating this as applicable.

summary: Synthetic improvement pack illustrating evidence boundaries and a creative proposal. No defect, implementation, or measured improvement is established.

omissions: No complete source document or exact tool version.
coverage.description: Only a synthetic partial preview is represented.

findings.summary: The synthetic partial preview reports a duplicated heading.

attribution.rationale: The fixture cannot distinguish component behavior from usage, configuration, host, or dependency behavior.

limitations: The real source and tool execution are not included; this is only a contract fixture.

findings.summary: A structure-only preview might make unintended changes easier to detect.

attribution.rationale: This is a proposed interface feature, not a proven root cause.

proposed_changes.title: Prototype a structure preview
proposed_changes.description: Display the planned heading tree and changed sections before applying a formatting operation.
proposed_changes.expected_benefit: Users may identify unintended structural changes before committing them.
risks: Extra review effort may outweigh the benefit on simple documents.
proposed_changes.rollback: Disable the optional preview and preserve the existing formatting flow.

validation_cases.title: Compare detection of unintended heading changes
validation_cases.context: Use held-out synthetic documents with known heading changes; record tool version and configuration.
procedure: Prepare distinct held-out documents and known structural changes.
Compare review with and without the prototype using the same evaluation criteria.
Record missed changes, review time, user feedback, and total cost.
validation_cases.expected_result: A useful improvement should reduce missed unintended changes without unacceptable review overhead. No numerical improvement is predicted as fact.
limitations: The fixture generator and original source documents are not bundled in this schema example.

risk_limits: No automatic publication, plugin modification, or execution of this proposal.

follow_up.description: Rerun the comparison under the new version and record actual outcomes before adopting the improvement.

coverage.description: Synthetic portable manifest; original content is not bundled.

residual_limits: Copies exported outside service control cannot be recalled automatically.
